notes.title: Version 1.02 now available
notes.notes:
[b]Juggly[/b] is now better than ever with the following improvements:

[list]
[*] New how to play section with examples and explanations!
[*] Fixed bug that caused cursor to go AWOL
[*] Made random speed level 10 a bit easier
[/list]

We hope you continue to enjoy playing Juggly.

[b]Happy New Year! [/b]
